description: Create a business partner (organization or person) in SAP, optionally as customer and/or supplier. Runs a DUPLICATE CHECK first (name, VAT number): a certain duplicate blocks the creation and is returned instead — set allow_duplicate only after a human confirmed it is a different partner. Company code / sales area data come from the connection defaults when extend_to_company_code is true. WRITES into the customer's ERP — permission gate + write log; dry run unless the connection is live.

allow_duplicate.description: Create even if a matching entry already exists

category.description: Whether the partner is an organization or a person

dry_run.description: true = build and log the request but send nothing. Writes are ALWAYS dry runs while the tenant's SAP connection has write_mode "dry_run" (the default).

extend_to_company_code.description: also create company code + sales area / purchasing data from the connection defaults

roles.description: Create the partner additionally as customer and/or supplier

name: create_sap_business_partner
